exclusive_cost_unit: Every selected codepoint has one owner; excluded furniture gets separate ownership in raw_untrimmed. Atomic tokens and collapsed runs belong to their first codepoint. Whole normalized text is conserved.
closure_policy: Prerequisite-to-use logical edges, including retained hypotheses; union exclusive owners before any sum. Parent and branch aliases never pay twice. Known passage subtotals do not turn unknown external expansions into zero.
context_policy: Every complete paper and acquisition stage includes title, context, definitions, bibliographic material and wrappers, even if an individual result route does not.
owner_granularity: Named statements and proofs, substantive branches, definitions, presentation/table data and context. Source and current granularity need not match.
